title: SOS full-screen override and cancel flow (E/O/H)
description: Implement SOS semantics from spec 19 §8. SOS reachable in ≤1 interaction from every screen on every tier. SOS overrides all screens immediately with inverse full-frame (E/O). H tier uses distinct fixed blink from §10 table. SOS never auto-cancels. Cancel = same hold again + confirm screen (E/O only). H tier has no cancel, only timeout. SOS rides normal send path with priority — no special radio mode. SOS is the only feature that may block on human input. Spans spec 19 requirements 44-53.
